BluePearl Gwinnett families:
Our Gwinnett and Johns Creek hospitals have united and will be serving you at our Johns Creek location! Our trusted team will continue to provide the same care you’ve come to expect.
BluePearl Pet Hospital - serving Johns Creek.
We are located in Johns Creek, just off Medlock Bridge Rd, northeast of Atlanta and just east of Alpharetta and Roswell.
Our reviews.
Our services.
Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency medicine
In an emergency, call your 24-hour emergency vet to let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary.
Specialty care
Our veterinary specialists work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.
See Specialties and Services

veterinarians.
Caring for your pets is our passion. Meet our team of veterinarians here to help you and your pet.
See Veterinarians
About BluePearl Pet Hospital Johns Creek.
Now part of the BluePearl family, our hospital was formerly known as Atlanta Veterinary Specialists, which opened in 1988.
While we have continued to grow, our dedication to our patients has remained the same, and we always remember our mission and core values: to provide exceptional patient care and passionate client service while improving the lives of every pet and family we work with.
Our team respects the close bond between pets and their owners. We treat each patient with dignity, compassion and kindness.
Pet owners.
At BluePearl Pet Hospital Johns Creek, providing our customers with remarkable service is a top priority. We’re committed to making your veterinary visit as smooth as possible.
Have questions prior to your visit? We’re happy to help. Contact our hospital team at

Testimonials.
For several days, Dansby required intensive, around-the-clock care. His team continuously reassessed his condition, making real-time decisions to support his brain function, breathing, and overall stability. During this time, his family stayed closely connected with his care team, receiving updates and guidance as everyone worked toward the same goal: helping Dansby recover and get back to his family, happy and healthy.
